title: LibreDWG dwg2dxf to FreeCAD artifact-integrity boundary
mode: Current primary-source research and read-only route audit; plan-only
scope: Reconcile an open FreeCAD report about LibreDWG dwg2dxf output with the current FreeCAD converter/importer route.
Distinguish historical malformed-output reports from current release evidence and local libdxfrw defects.
Refine the existing FreeCAD Linux/Windows composed qualification checkpoint without new routine tests, fixtures, or peer builds.

sources.revision: Mutable current source/docs and issue state reviewed 2026-10-20; historical reproductions identify FreeCAD 1.0.0 and 1.2 development plus LibreDWG 0.13.3.7835.
sources.observed: Issue #19247 remains open with Confirmed and Needs example file labels. The initial report says FreeCAD 1.0.0 rejects output from LibreDWG dwg2dxf. A maintainer examining the attached DXF diagnosed empty/missing group-code/value pairs in header variables and LTYPE/STYLE records. A later retest comment reports unresolved anonymous block references, no-geometry shapes, and entity-read exceptions on FreeCAD 1.2 development with LibreDWG 0.13.3.7835. Current importDWG.py routes conversion output to the selected DXF importer and its LibreDWG branch uses output-path existence, not child return code or strict parse, as the handoff check. The docs describe materially different C++ and legacy importer subsets and state that stock FreeCAD does not read ACIS/SAT solids.
sources.limits: Issue attachments and historical builds were not downloaded or rerun. The issue does not establish whether current LibreDWG or current FreeCAD still has the same behavior. Mutable docs/source are route descriptions, not a native result.

sources.revision: Current public issue/NEWS pages reviewed 2026-10-20; issue #1052 is closed, #1408 is open, NEWS has a 0.14.1 section.
sources.observed: Issue #1052 reports a missing DXF group code for a string-valued $DIMBLK1 header variable. Open #1408 reports LibreDWG 0.14 Windows output for complex CR-bearing TEXT/MTEXT with an empty line in a group-code position, a lost leading character, and exit status 0. The 0.14.1 NEWS section lists multiple DXF fixes but does not identify #19247 as resolved.
sources.limits: The reports cover distinct artifacts and failure modes. #1408's full reproducer is not public in the report. Release notes cannot prove either a current failure or fix for #19247, and peer reports do not establish a libdxfrw defect.
